Angry Boy (Japanese: VSオーベム VS ), titled VS Beheeyem in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 535th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 11th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Beheeyem (Japanese: アングリー・ボーイ Angry Boy) in the VIZ Media translation and Angry Boy in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Hugh finds that his sister managed to sneak onto Pop Roxie's boat.
Leo befriends Hugh's sister and promises to help Hugh keep her out of sight from everyone else.
After arriving at Castelia City, Roxie discovers an injured man that was attacked by a group of villains who "liberated" his .
, , Hugh, and Roxie travel to the Castelia Sewers, where they find the culprits were Team Plasma, including Bronius and Ryoku.
Hugh attacks the s, but is swarmed by their Pokémon, forcing the group to scatter.
contacts Hugh via his , but Hugh mistakenly believes that Croagunk is the one who is talking.
At the Cold Storage, Colress confronts Zinzolin about information about .
